mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS submitCount, SUM(pass != #{judging}) AS judgedCount, SUM(pass = #{pass}) AS passCount FROM tb_user_submit WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT s.question_id AS questionId, COUNT(*) AS submitCount, SUM(s.pass != #{judging}) AS judgedCount, SUM(s.pass = #{pass}) AS passCount FROM tb_user_submit s INNER JOIN tb_question q ON q.question_id = s.question_id GROUP BY s.question_id HAVING judgedCount >= #{minJudged} ORDER BY passCount / judgedCount, judgedCount DESC, s.question_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: SELECT s.question_id, COUNT(*) AS submitCount, SUM(s.pass != #{judging}) AS judgedCount, SUM(s.pass = #{pass}) AS passCount FROM tb_user_submit s INNER JOIN tb_question q ON q.question_id = s.question_id GROUP BY s.question_id HAVING judgedCount >= #{minJudged}
mapper.select: SELECT h.question_id AS questionId, h.submitCount, h.judgedCount, h.passCount, COALESCE(f.caseFailCount, 0) AS caseFailCount, f.topCaseId, COALESCE(f.topCaseFailCount, 0) AS topCaseFailCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_submit_appeal a WHERE a.question_id = h.question_id AND a.status = #{upheld} AND a.delete_state = 0) AS upheldAppealCount FROM () h LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.question_id, SUM(c.failCount) AS caseFailCount, MAX(CASE WHEN c.rn = 1 THEN c.fail_case_id END) AS topCaseId, MAX(CASE WHEN c.rn = 1 THEN c.failCount END) AS topCaseFailCount FROM ( SELECT question_id, fail_case_id, COUNT(*) AS failCount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY question_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, fail_case_id) AS rn FROM tb_user_submit WHERE pass = #{notPass} AND fail_case_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY question_id, fail_case_id ) c GROUP BY c.question_id ) f ON f.question_id = h.question_id ORDER BY h.passCount / h.judgedCount, h.judgedCount DESC, h.question_id

SELECT t.tag_name AS tagName, COUNT(*) AS questionCount, SUM(h.submitCount) AS submitCount, SUM(h.judgedCount) AS judgedCount, SUM(h.passCount) AS passCount FROM () h INNER JOIN tb_question_tag qt ON qt.question_id = h.question_id AND qt.delete_state = 0 INNER JOIN tb_tag t ON t.tag_id = qt.tag_id AND t.delete_state = 0 GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name ORDER BY SUM(h.passCount) / SUM(h.judgedCount), judgedCount DESC, t.tag_id

SELECT s.judge_status AS judgeStatus, COUNT(*) AS failCount FROM tb_user_submit s INNER JOIN () h ON h.question_id = s.question_id WHERE s.pass = #{notPass} AND s.judge_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.judge_status ORDER BY failCount DESC, s.judge_status
